3a1c0af2fe50df79ac0bb7cbf0d63c39.png.notes: Credit: Patrick H. Lauke (FontStruct), reshared by AnthonyCassimiro. The repository operator did not create the font. Source xevious_hud_font.png at SHA-256 87095dc731a54115850ce3509de70380f7707dbc977d0efa0df08b89a057da56; glyphs cropped by SHEET_TEXT_RECTS and nearest-neighbor decimated, white ink on transparent, bitmapResolution 2. Costumes on the start_screen target, all on the smaller 108px monospace cell at 6x (slice-18 playtest scale correction to match the HUD GAME OVER glyphs; one 20px column at the drawn size since slice 20): the title-screen text — the credit-counter digits, the CREDIT / PUSH START / INSERT COIN prompts, and the CAB-02 1P/2P start-selector labels (port-original control text — the arcade had no on-screen selector); the PRES-01 best-five header (port-original wording) and ordinal rank labels 1ST-5TH; and the CAB-04 per-letter name-cell glyphs (A-Z and ".") for the LIVE best-five table (the digits double as its score column). Only the letterforms are the credited font; the table's CONTENT — the port-original initials (NOT the ROM default name strings) and the arcade default scores — lives in the Stage lists game_director owns, not in any costume.

Costumes on the start_screen target, all on the smaller 108px monospace cell at 6x (slice-18 playtest scale correction to match the HUD GAME OVER glyphs; one 20px column at the drawn size since slice 20): the title-screen text — the credit-counter digits, the CREDIT / PUSH START / INSERT COIN prompts, and the CAB-02 1P/2P start-selector labels (port-original control text — the arcade had no on-screen selector); the PRES-01 best-five header (port-original wording) and ordinal rank labels 1ST-5TH; and the CAB-04 per-letter name-cell glyphs (A-Z and ".") for the LIVE best-five table (the digits double as its score column). Costumes on the start_screen target, all on the smaller 108px monospace cell at 6x (slice-18 playtest scale correction to match the HUD GAME OVER glyphs; one 20px column at the drawn size since slice 20): the title-screen text — the credit-counter digits, the CREDIT / PUSH START / INSERT COIN prompts, and the CAB-02 1P/2P start-selector labels (port-original control text — the arcade had no on-screen selector); the PRES-01 best-five header (port-original wording) and ordinal rank labels 1ST-5TH; and the CAB-04 per-letter name-cell glyphs (A-Z and ".") for the LIVE best-five table (the digits double as its score column). Source xevious_hud_font.png at SHA-256 87095dc731a54115850ce3509de70380f7707dbc977d0efa0df08b89a057da56; glyphs cropped by SHEET_TEXT_RECTS and nearest-neighbor decimated, white ink on transparent, bitmapResolution 2. Costumes on the start_screen target, all on the smaller 108px monospace cell at 6x (slice-18 playtest scale correction to match the HUD GAME OVER glyphs; one 20px column at the drawn size since slice 20): the title-screen text — the credit-counter digits, the CREDIT / PUSH START / INSERT COIN prompts, and the CAB-02 1P/2P start-selector labels (port-original control text — the arcade had no on-screen selector); the PRES-01 best-five header (port-original wording) and ordinal rank labels 1ST-5TH; and the CAB-04 per-letter name-cell glyphs (A-Z and ".") for the LIVE best-five table (the digits double as its score column). Only the letterforms are the credited font; the table's CONTENT — the port-original initials (NOT the ROM default name strings) and the arcade default scores — lives in the Stage lists game_director owns, not in any costume.

Source xevious_hud_font.png at SHA-256 87095dc731a54115850ce3509de70380f7707dbc977d0efa0df08b89a057da56; glyphs cropped by SHEET_TEXT_RECTS and nearest-neighbor decimated, white ink on transparent, bitmapResolution 2. Costumes on the start_screen target, all on the smaller 108px monospace cell at 6x (slice-18 playtest scale correction to match the HUD GAME OVER glyphs; one 20px column at the drawn size since slice 20): the title-screen text — the credit-counter digits, the CREDIT / PUSH START / INSERT COIN prompts, and the CAB-02 1P/2P start-selector labels (port-original control text — the arcade had no on-screen selector); the PRES-01 best-five header (port-original wording) and ordinal rank labels 1ST-5TH; and the CAB-04 per-letter name-cell glyphs (A-Z and ".") for the LIVE best-five table (the digits double as its score column). Only the letterforms are the credited font; the table's CONTENT — the port-original initials (NOT the ROM default name strings) and the arcade default scores — lives in the Stage lists game_director owns, not in any costume.

Row 5: the bank-1 bomb tiles 0x11C/0x11D/0x11E at colours 0x25-0x28 (2468-2488); the enemy bullet is tile 0x11E at those colours (4763; xevious_sub.68k 208-218) and reuses the last four cells. e5ddc81186ddf86403062085ac08563d.png.notes: Credit: Patrick H. Lauke (FontStruct), reshared by AnthonyCassimiro. The repository operator did not create the font. Source xevious_hud_font.png at SHA-256 87095dc731a54115850ce3509de70380f7707dbc977d0efa0df08b89a057da56; glyphs cropped by SHEET_TEXT_RECTS and nearest-neighbor decimated, white ink on transparent, bitmapResolution 2. Costumes on the start_screen target, all on the smaller 108px monospace cell at 6x (slice-18 playtest scale correction to match the HUD GAME OVER glyphs; one 20px column at the drawn size since slice 20): the title-screen text — the credit-counter digits, the CREDIT / PUSH START / INSERT COIN prompts, and the CAB-02 1P/2P start-selector labels (port-original control text — the arcade had no on-screen selector); the PRES-01 best-five header (port-original wording) and ordinal rank labels 1ST-5TH; and the CAB-04 per-letter name-cell glyphs (A-Z and ".") for the LIVE best-five table (the digits double as its score column). Only the letterforms are the credited font; the table's CONTENT — the port-original initials (NOT the ROM default name strings) and the arcade default scores — lives in the Stage lists game_director owns, not in any costume.

Costumes on the start_screen target, all on the smaller 108px monospace cell at 6x (slice-18 playtest scale correction to match the HUD GAME OVER glyphs; one 20px column at the drawn size since slice 20): the title-screen text — the credit-counter digits, the CREDIT / PUSH START / INSERT COIN prompts, and the CAB-02 1P/2P start-selector labels (port-original control text — the arcade had no on-screen selector); the PRES-01 best-five header (port-original wording) and ordinal rank labels 1ST-5TH; and the CAB-04 per-letter name-cell glyphs (A-Z and ".") for the LIVE best-five table (the digits double as its score column). Only the letterforms are the credited font; the table's CONTENT — the port-original initials (NOT the ROM default name strings) and the arcade default scores — lives in the Stage lists game_director owns, not in any costume.
